description: Machine-readable contract for the declaration-only dimension recoding rules and synthetic question-type input paths implemented by the generic calculator. These are technical behaviors, not instrument support or clinical approval.

rules.operation: select the first inclusive [min,max] band and return its 0..3 value; if no band matches, preserve the raw score

rules.input: two TIME answers (bedtime and wake time) in HH:mm
rules.operation: compute elapsed minutes, adding 24 hours when wake time is earlier than bedtime, then select the first inclusive [min,max] band and return its 0..3 value

rules.input: two TIME answers plus a numeric sleep-minutes answer
rules.operation: compute elapsed bed minutes, calculate sleepMinutes / bedMinutes * 100, then select the first inclusive [min,max] band and return its 0..3 value

governanceBoundary: Synthetic technical fixtures contain no original instrument questions, translations, norms or interpretation claims. This registry does not establish PSQI or any other instrument support; real materials, authorization, professional dual review and business acceptance remain required.
